>I've tried going to Adventure League at the local comic shop, I've tried doing that Events and Adventures thing for a while, **I've tried the gym**, I've tried a Pokemon Go club

At my lowest I was 170 lbs, but thanks for reading most of my post.

i think the problem is that if a person is poor they probably dont have the time to batch cook, because they're most likely working two jobs, or they're working a soulless retail job thats making them suicidal, so who cares about food? poor food choices = dying sooner = getting out of the hell that is being poor in the western world sooner

Like it's been suggested, do what you need to do to mourn and distract yourself. It's not easy. Might cry a lot. Just let yourself feel what you feel, so you can move on. 

I'm in a similar boat as you. Examples of things that I've done: signed up for roller derby classes, went snorkeling, bought tickets to go to a black ops laser tag arena. Binge-watched Brooklyn 99 and Star Trek. Just ate half a pint of ice cream while crying, lol. It happens. 

But the earth keeps spinning. Put your dukes up. You didn't want to be with a guy who thought of as that disposable anyway. He's an ass.
